records.text: Andrew started a new job as a Financial Analyst during the week of March 20–26, 2023, describing it as a significant change from his previous job.
Audrey bought new collars and tags for her dogs and shared a photo showing two dogs standing in grass with their mouths open, wearing the new collars.
Audrey said she has had her dogs for three years as of March 27, 2023, and named them Pepper, Precious, and Panda.
Audrey feels deeply attached to her dogs and said she cannot live without them; the dogs bring Audrey a great deal of happiness.
Audrey described Pepper, Precious, and Panda as city dogs. Audrey frequently explores new parks and trails with them, and they often go on adventures together.
Andrew does not currently have any pets, but Andrew loves animals.
Andrew has always been awed by birds, especially their ability to soar and explore new places.
Andrew is especially fascinated by eagles, which Andrew considers strong and graceful.
Andrew shared a photo showing two birds flying in the sky with the sun shining behind them.
Andrew has not specifically gone bird-watching, but Andrew spots birds while hiking.
On March 27, 2023, Audrey asked Andrew about his favorite hiking spots; Andrew had not yet answered by the end of the segment.
Andrew said Fox Hollow is a great trail for weekend hikes and has awesome views.
Audrey plans to try hiking the Fox Hollow trail and tell Andrew how she likes it.
Andrew and Audrey exchanged friendly farewells after discussing Audrey's planned hike at Fox Hollow.

On April 2, 2023, Audrey told Andrew that she and her household had adopted another puppy named Pixie. Pixie is a small white dog, shown sitting on a carpet in a shared photo, and Audrey described Pixie as extremely cute.
As of April 2, 2023, Audrey had not yet visited Fox Hollow, the hiking spot Andrew previously recommended, because caring for the new puppy Pixie had kept her busy.

By April 2, 2023, Pixie had adjusted well to Audrey's other dogs, Pepper, Precious, and Panda. Pixie took several days to get used to the other dogs, and then became friends with them; the dogs played together and explored Audrey's house. Audrey shared a photo showing one dog playing with a group of other dogs.

By April 2, 2023, Pepper had initially needed time to adjust to Pixie but had become closely bonded with Pixie; Audrey said Pepper and Pixie were always together. Audrey shared a photo of two dogs standing in grass near a fence.

As of April 2, 2023, Andrew was considering getting a dog but was concerned that finding a dog-friendly place in the city could be challenging. Andrew asked Audrey for advice about finding dog-friendly housing.

Audrey told Andrew that she and her household used websites with dog-friendly housing filters to find a place that allowed dogs. She said the filters made the search easy and helped them find a perfect place. Audrey shared a photo of a dog sitting in a field of flowers.
Andrew plans to use dog-friendly housing websites to look for an apartment and intends to keep searching until he finds a suitable dog-friendly place and a furry friend.
Andrew wants a furry dog companion for cuddling and companionship and is excited about eventually spending time with a dog.
Andrew shared a photo of his family's dog sitting on a couch in a living room.
Audrey shared a photo of one of her dogs lying on a couch beside a pillow during lazy couch time.
Andrew misses exploring nature trails with his family's dog and values the peaceful moments, bonding, and memories created by hiking with a dog.
Andrew shared a photo of a man walking a dog on a trail.
Audrey would like to hike and explore nature with her four dogs—Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie—and make memories with them.
Andrew shared a photo of a man sitting on a rock with a dog.
Andrew wants to find a dog-friendly outdoor spot soon so he can resume exploring nature trails and create new memories with a dog.
On April 2, 2023, Andrew told Audrey that he would keep her posted and then said goodbye.
On April 16, 2023, Andrew told Audrey that he and his girlfriend had visited a new city cafe the previous weekend, enjoyed the cafe experience, and felt sad that they were not in nature.
Andrew feels most thriving, connected, and spiritually at home in nature; he finds hiking and natural surroundings peaceful, breathtaking, soothing, and restorative when life becomes chaotic.

Audrey believes nature provides beauty, peace, grounding, perspective, and a reminder that people are part of something bigger than themselves; Audrey contrasts this with the concrete jungle of city life.
Audrey enjoys walking her dogs in the park because it helps her find her center and recharge.
Andrew said city living makes it difficult for him to spend time outdoors and that he misses his connection to nature and the companionship associated with it; he sometimes feels he is missing out.
Andrew and his girlfriend enjoy discovering new places to eat around town as a way to try new things and unwind after a long week.
Andrew and his girlfriend discovered a cafe with appealing pastries. Andrew shared a photo showing a bakery display with pastries and coffee.
Andrew and his girlfriend ate croissants, muffins, and tarts at the cafe, and Andrew said the pastries tasted great.
Audrey made some of her favorite treats during the week before April 16, 2023, and shared a photo of a muffin pan containing blueberries and muffins.

Audrey proposed having a pastry party with Andrew, and Andrew agreed to attend; Audrey plans for Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie to come along, giving Andrew a chance to spend time with all four dogs.
Audrey shared a photo showing one dog running with three other dogs in the background while discussing how much joy her dogs bring her.
Audrey says her dogs mean the world to her and that she cannot imagine life without them; she has tattoos of her dogs on her arm.
Audrey shared a photo of a woman with a tattoo depicting a dog and sunflowers. Audrey said the tattoo represents her love for her dogs and the beauty of nature.
Audrey shared a photo depicting a woman walking with her dogs in the woods, combining her love of her dogs with her appreciation for nature.
Audrey has dog tattoos because she has always shared a strong bond with her four dogs—Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie—and wants to see their happy faces even when they are not with her.
Audrey says her four dogs make her very happy, and Andrew thinks it is awesome that the dogs bring so much joy into Audrey's life.

On 2023-04-28 or shortly before 2023-05-03, Audrey went on a hike and watched a hummingbird dart around with its wings spread; Audrey photographed the hummingbird perched on a branch with its wings open.
By 2023-05-03, Andrew had found a new open space near his city home where he could hike, and Andrew described hiking there as refreshing. Andrew photographed a lake and mountains at sunset.
Andrew usually tries to escape the city and hike at least once every weekend as a much-needed break.
Andrew experiences nature as therapeutic, peaceful, and invigorating; greenery, mountain air, and being outdoors help Andrew feel calm and refreshed.

Andrew tries to photograph special peaceful outdoor moments and share the resulting feeling with other people. Andrew believes sharing peaceful experiences can motivate people to find their own peace and create a ripple effect of positivity, joy, and calm.
Audrey believes that sharing something peaceful or kind can make a significant difference to others, and that both the recipient and the person spreading positivity benefit emotionally.

On 2023-05-03, Audrey said caring for Audrey's four dogs—Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie—and spending time with them was fulfilling. Audrey shared a photograph of several dogs sitting on a lush green field.

Audrey's dogs, Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie, love hiking, exploring new scents, and being in nature; Audrey recognizes their enjoyment from their wagging tails and expressions. Audrey described nature as the dogs' happy place and shared a photograph of a dog running in a field with other dogs.

Audrey considers outdoor dog safety very important. Audrey uses special safety equipment, including leashes and dog shoes, even though the dogs look funny wearing it; Audrey shared a photograph of a dog wearing a leash and shoes.

When Audrey walks Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie, the dogs commonly play fetch with a ball or frisbee, meet other dog owners in the park, and participate in doggie playdates. Audrey enjoys chatting with other people while the dogs make new friends; Audrey shared a photograph of a dog catching a frisbee in a field.

Audrey's dogs have abundant energy, adore fetch, and enjoy meeting new canine friends at playdates. The dogs become excited when Audrey brings out their fetch toys; Audrey shared a photograph of a dog wearing a party hat on a couch.

Audrey's dogs tolerate party hats because Audrey puts the hats on them for fun and gives them treats. Audrey recommends a dog park as a good place to begin arranging dog playdates because dogs can run and mingle there; Audrey shared a photograph of a dog jumping through a ring in a park.
Audrey told Andrew on May 3, 2023, that a suggested spot is located right by the park Audrey and Andrew usually walk near; the spot has many trees and benches where they can watch Audrey's dogs play.
Andrew plans to check out the spot near the usual walking park and tell Audrey how it goes.
Andrew and Audrey ended their conversation on May 3, 2023, warmly, with Andrew saying it is always great chatting with Audrey and that he would talk to Audrey later.

Andrew is actively searching for a dog to adopt. Since before 2023-05-06, Andrew has browsed adoption websites, visited shelters, and asked friends for recommendations; he describes the process as fun but annoying and is still looking for the right furry companion.

Andrew believes prospective dog owners should consider their living-space size and the dog's exercise needs. Because Andrew lives in an apartment, Andrew thinks a smaller dog would be the best fit; active people may instead consider a dog that enjoys playing and running.

Andrew is searching for pet-friendly housing by contacting landlords and checking neighborhoods. Andrew wants to live near a park or woods so Andrew can stay close to nature and give a future dog a large open space to run.
On 2023-05-06, Andrew shared a photograph of a dog looking through a cage toward the camera, reflecting Andrew's shelter and adoption search.
On 2023-05-05, Audrey took her dogs on a road trip to a beautiful national park. Audrey said the dogs had a blast, and she shared a photograph of three dogs running through a grassy field.

Audrey takes her dogs on road trips approximately once every couple of months because road trips let the dogs explore and stay active. Audrey considers traveling with furry companions fun, exciting, and something to look forward to.
Audrey supports Andrew's dog search and offers encouragement and advice, wishing Andrew luck in finding the perfect dog.
Andrew wants to take a road trip with a future dog and has added that experience to his bucket list; Andrew looks forward to traveling with a dog after adoption.
On May 6, 2023, Andrew planned to visit another animal shelter soon while continuing his search to adopt a dog.
On May 6, 2023, Audrey offered to provide Andrew with suggestions or help during his dog-adoption search, and Andrew expressed appreciation.
On May 6, 2023, Audrey said she expected Andrew to send her a picture of his future dog, and Andrew said he could not wait to adopt one.
On May 6, 2023, Audrey wished Andrew fun at the shelter and the two friends ended their conversation until later.

On 2023-05-06, Andrew hiked at a recently discovered outdoor spot with friends and his girlfriend; he described the nature as peaceful and relaxing. Andrew shared a photo of a dirt path leading to a grassy hill.

During the week of 2023-05-08, Audrey spent most of her free time caring for her four dogs—Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie—and keeping them happy and healthy. Audrey shared a photo showing a group of dogs, with one dog marked by a yellow circle.

Audrey signed up for a pet-bonding workshop scheduled for June 2023, after seeing a flyer at her local pet store. The workshop is a positive-reinforcement training class intended to strengthen her bond with her dogs and improve their behavior.
At Audrey's local pet store, a volunteer let Audrey meet the store volunteer's dog; Audrey described the dog as friendly and playful.

Audrey believes positive reinforcement is the proper way to teach pets how to behave, while punishment is never appropriate. Audrey does not want to hurt any of her dogs and said that even thinking about hurting them causes her pain.
Audrey considers her dogs quick learners who love rewards and expects them to learn positive-reinforcement training quickly.
Audrey offered to update Andrew about her dogs' training progress and share training tips for Andrew's future dog.
Andrew said he would look into the positive-reinforcement training classes and became nearly convinced to take the class after Audrey recommended it.
On 2023-06-01, Audrey took her dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie to a park, where they ran and played off leash. Audrey felt joyful and peaceful because of the dogs' happiness.
On 2023-06-02, Andrew shared a photo showing a sunset over a mountain range with a horse grazing while discussing Audrey's hiking trips with her dogs.

During the week before 2023-06-02, Audrey took Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie hiking in a national park and reached a beautiful peak at sunset. Audrey described the experience as paradise-like, with a pleasant breeze and birds chirping, while her dogs ran around. This was a separate or more recent national-park outing than Audrey's previously recorded 2023-05-05 trip.
On 2023-06-02, Audrey shared a photo from her national-park outing showing two horses in a field beside a fence; Audrey considered it one of her favorite photos.
Audrey finds that nature cheers her up and makes her feel grateful.

As of 2023-06-02, Andrew was still searching for a smaller dog and a pet-friendly place in the city, but had not found a suitable place. Andrew felt somewhat discouraged but remained determined to find the right home and dog.

On 2023-06-02, Audrey asked Andrew to email his housing criteria so Audrey could help him find a suitable pet-friendly place for Andrew and his future dog. Audrey and Andrew planned to continue searching, and Audrey encouraged Andrew to stay positive.
Audrey actively supports Andrew's search for a suitable pet-friendly home and future dog, and Andrew appreciates Audrey's assistance.

On 2023-06-11, Andrew attended a rock climbing class with his friends, climbed to the top, and found the experience challenging, satisfying, and fantastic. Andrew was a beginner, felt proud and accomplished, and credited his friends' support and encouragement for helping him succeed.
On 2023-06-11, Andrew shared a photo showing the view from the top of the rock he climbed and a photo of a man climbing a rock face.

Andrew is enthusiastic about doing more outdoor activities every week after his successful rock climbing experience; he specifically mentioned kayaking and possibly bungee jumping. Andrew feels that nature pushes him outside his comfort zone and helps him reset, refresh his mind, and gain a different outlook.
Audrey invited Andrew to join Audrey and Audrey's dogs for a walk in a small park with a tree-surrounded trail, and Andrew accepted because he wanted to spend time in nature with the dogs.

Audrey usually walks Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie for about one hour, varying the duration by day and allowing the dogs to explore at their own pace. The dogs need exercise and exploration, return home smiling and tired, and become visibly excited when Audrey prepares for a walk.
Audrey shared a photo from a dog walk showing two of Audrey's dogs running in a field with a ball in one dog's mouth.
Audrey shared a photo showing two of Audrey's dogs playing with a frisbee in a meadow. Andrew described the dogs as content and the meadow as pleasant.

Audrey feels joy, peace, inspiration, and centeredness when she is outdoors with Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie; being in nature with the dogs is Audrey's happy place. Audrey believes nature makes people and pets feel alive, think differently, and feel calm.
Andrew appreciates nature and believes that being outdoors benefits people and pets by bringing happiness, calming the mind, and providing a reset.
On 2023-06-26, Audrey got a new place with a bigger backyard for her dogs Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie. Audrey shared a photo showing two of her dogs sitting on the grass in front of the house.
On 2023-06-26, Audrey said Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie were settling into the new backyard well, enjoying the space to run, explore, and sniff new smells.
On 2023-06-26, Audrey said she had set up a doggy play area in the new backyard with agility equipment and toys for Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie.
On 2023-06-26, Andrew shared a photo showing a group of dogs playing with a ball in a large indoor area at the doggy daycare near Andrew.
On 2023-06-26, Audrey said Audrey would look into Andrew's nearby doggy daycare and would like to take Pepper, Precious, Panda, and Pixie there sometime soon.
On 2023-06-26, Andrew offered to help Audrey find more places for Audrey's dogs, and Audrey appreciated having friends who understand her love for pets.

On 2023-06-26, Audrey and Andrew agreed that dogs and animals bring great joy; Audrey said Audrey could not imagine life without animals, and Andrew said people who understand love for dogs are awesome.
Andrew and Audrey both believe animals and pets deserve appreciation; Audrey regards pets as family and does not understand people who hate or hurt pets.
On June 26, 2023, Andrew shared a photo of a neighborhood park flower bed containing many differently colored flowers.
Audrey thought the many-colored flowers in Andrew's neighborhood park looked beautiful.
On June 26, 2023, Audrey was unpacking boxes after moving into a new house.
On June 23, 2023, Andrew hiked with friends in pleasant weather, enjoyed being outdoors, and took photographs that Andrew had not yet reviewed.
During Andrew's June 23, 2023 hike, Andrew enjoyed hearing birdsong and smelling trees in the open air.
Andrew has recently been missing a strong connection with nature and the peace that nature brings, and Andrew wants to explore more outdoor environments.
Audrey finds nature soothing and recharging, wants to do another nature outing, and values the peacefulness of natural settings.
A few years before June 26, 2023, Audrey and Audrey's friends hiked in the mountains, discovered a stunning lake, sat beside the lake, chatted, and admired the peaceful natural surroundings.

On June 26, 2023, Audrey shared two photos from the mountain-lake experience: one showing a person's feet resting on a rock overlooking a lake, and another showing a person sitting on a rock overlooking the lake.
Audrey remembers the mountain lake and surrounding nature as calming and exactly what Audrey needed at the time; Andrew thought the photographed location looked peaceful and like a great spot.
Audrey believes people should appreciate life's small things and not take anything for granted.
On July 3, 2023, Audrey was taking a challenging but rewarding dog-training course, and Audrey's dogs were already behaving better because of the course.
On July 3, 2023, Andrew had been unable to find a dog-friendly place to rent, which he found frustrating; Andrew said life had recently thrown him a few unspecified curveballs.
As of July 3, 2023, Audrey had not had much time to explore new trails because the dog-training course was a major time commitment.
On July 3, 2023, Andrew was missing the peace of being outdoors on trails and was limiting himself to urban adventures while he could not hike.
Audrey feels that her dogs give her a great deal of love and happiness, and Audrey finds nature calming and restorative when she is with her dogs.
On July 3, 2023, Audrey shared a photo showing two of Audrey's dogs running in a field, each with a ball in its mouth.
Audrey has four dogs, all of which are mixed-breed dogs: two are Jack Russell mixes and two are Chihuahua mixes.
Audrey's four dogs especially enjoy running and playing fetch.
On July 3, 2023, Audrey shared a photo showing two of Audrey's dogs curled up comfortably in a dog bed.
All four of Audrey's dogs were 3 years old as of July 3, 2023, and they formed a harmonious pack.
On June 30, 2023, Audrey hosted a doggy playdate for Audrey's dogs; the playdate was somewhat chaotic but enjoyable.
On July 3, 2023, Audrey shared a photo showing two of Audrey's dogs lying on a couch under a blanket.
Audrey considers her four dogs her universe.
Because Andrew could not hike, Andrew had been exploring new hobbies, including cooking more and trying new recipes, which Andrew found enjoyable.
Audrey loves cooking, and Audrey's favorite recipe is chicken pot pie, which Audrey considers cozy and delicious, especially on a cold day.
On July 3, 2023, Audrey shared a photo showing a baked pie on a wooden board with a knife, associated with Audrey's chicken pot pie recipe.

On July 3, 2023, Audrey shared a photo of a pie with a lattice crust and offered Andrew her family's longstanding pie recipe, which evokes memories of her grandmother's kitchen and conversations at the family table.

Andrew said cooking helps him de-stress and be creative; although Andrew considers himself a rookie, he enjoys experimenting and cooking is becoming one of his favorite hobbies because it is relaxing and expressive.
Audrey enjoys trying new recipes and experimenting in the kitchen because cooking feels like an escape, helps her de-stress, and lets her creativity flow.
Audrey experiences cooking and eating the finished food as rewarding self-care and therapy. Audrey likes putting on music, pouring a glass of wine, and going with the flow while cooking.
On July 3, 2023, Audrey shared a photo of a plate of food containing many vegetables while discussing how calming and therapeutic cooking can be.
Garlic is Audrey's go-to kitchen ingredient because Audrey loves the smell and taste that garlic adds to dishes.
Audrey's favorite garlic-based dish is roasted chicken. Audrey shared a photo of a pan containing chicken and potatoes on a stove and offered Andrew the recipe.
Audrey's roasted chicken recipe is inspired by Mediterranean flavors and includes chicken, garlic, lemon, and herbs; Audrey considers it an easy, healthy comfort meal.
Andrew is interested in healthier meal ideas and appreciated Audrey sharing the roasted chicken recipe; Andrew plans to make it and tell Audrey how it turns out.
Andrew plans to try Audrey's roasted chicken recipe and said he will keep Audrey updated about how it goes.
Andrew and Audrey ended their conversation cordially on July 3, 2023, with Andrew promising to provide an update and Audrey expressing excitement to hear about it.

On June 30, 2023, Andrew had an enjoyable picnic with his girlfriend in nature; he said being in nature feels refreshing and brings him joy. A shared photo showed a picnic table with assorted snacks and drinks.
Audrey has multiple dogs, which she affectionately calls her furry friends, and said her dogs make her happy. Audrey recently took the dogs on a walk and felt good afterward.
Andrew would like to own a dog, but finding a suitable place to live and finding the right dog have been difficult for him.
Audrey obtained her dogs from a nearby breeder that had the dogs she wanted. She said finding places that allow dogs is difficult.
Andrew has found several parks where dogs can be taken on leash, but he prefers an open area where dogs can run and play freely. He offered to tell Audrey if he finds a suitable location.
Audrey and Andrew agreed to go on a hike together in August 2023, with Audrey bringing her dogs. They want a trail with a great view and ample room for the dogs to explore and run freely.
Andrew suggested a trail for the August 2023 dog hike; a shared photo showed a woman walking up a steep hill with an ocean view. Andrew later shared a map showing a tree-filled park.
Audrey considers safety the top priority when her dogs are running outdoors. Audrey and Andrew agreed to check that the hiking trail is safe for the dogs before the hike.

On July 8, 2023, Audrey shared a photo of three of her dogs sitting indoors on the floor with leashes. She said the dogs were ready for their next outdoor adventure, and Andrew said he looked forward to meeting them.
Audrey said her dogs bring her substantial joy, are very energetic, and make her smile. She feels especially happy when she sees the dogs looking happy and bouncy.
Audrey shared a photo of two of her dogs running in a field while carrying a ball in their mouths. Andrew described the dogs as adorable and said seeing them enjoy themselves made him happy.

Audrey shared a photo of one of her dogs playing with a group of other dogs at a local park. She said the dogs already looked very happy there and expressed confidence that the upcoming hike would be a great day.
Andrew enjoys being outdoors and likes seeing other people and animals enjoy outdoor activities. He is very excited about hiking with Audrey and her dogs in August 2023.
Audrey shared a photo from a hike in 2022 showing a person standing on a mountain with a scenic sky and sunset. She described the sunset as very pretty.

On July 8, 2023, Audrey shared a photo showing a lake and mountains at sunset. Audrey said she had hiked at the pictured location in 2022, that it was a three-hour drive from Audrey's home, and that the sunset was amazing.

Audrey described the lake-and-mountains sunset as a beautiful, peaceful moment with vibrant colors that made Audrey feel grateful, reminded Audrey to appreciate small things, and demonstrated nature's breathtaking surprises.

Andrew enjoys appreciating nature, scenic views, sunsets, and the unexpected beauty of natural surroundings; Andrew called the pictured sunset and view stunning and said that taking time to appreciate such moments makes life feel awesome.
Audrey believes that pausing to appreciate beautiful moments makes life much better and gives Audrey a feeling of peace.
On July 11, 2023, Andrew introduced Toby, his new puppy, whom Andrew had recently taken home despite living in the city. Andrew shared a photo of Toby sitting on a leash in a room.
Toby, Andrew's puppy, brings Andrew a lot of joy.
As of July 11, 2023, Andrew's work had been piling up, leaving Andrew stuck inside and feeling stressed. Andrew missed the peace and freedom of hiking.
Audrey considers hiking a good way to relax and experience nature.

Andrew planned to go on a hike in August 2023 and invited Audrey and Audrey's dogs to join Andrew and Toby. The planned group hike is intended as a break from Andrew's stressful work and a chance to enjoy nature together.
Audrey has multiple dogs, and Audrey said the dogs could join the planned hike with Andrew and Toby.
On July 11, 2023, Audrey showed Andrew a photo of a group of wooden keychains with engraved names. Audrey had made the personalized tags for Audrey's dogs.
Andrew thought Audrey's personalized wooden dog tags looked great and found it cool that Audrey had made them.
Audrey personally made wooden engraved-name tags for each of her dogs, customizing every tag to be special and fit the individual dog's personality.
Audrey put substantial love into making personalized tags because Audrey wants each of Audrey's pets to feel seen and loved.
Andrew and Audrey agree that small acts of love, such as personalized name tags, show care and make a big difference in relationships with their dogs.
Andrew and Audrey's dogs bring Andrew and Audrey a great deal of joy, and Andrew and Audrey believe their dogs deserve to be shown how special they are.

Andrew and Audrey are excited for their planned August 2023 hike, where Andrew's puppy Toby and Audrey's dogs will meet; Andrew and Audrey expect the hike to be fun, adventurous, relaxing, and a memorable experience.
As of July 11, 2023, Andrew and Audrey were counting down to their August 2023 hike and planned to begin preparing Andrew's puppy Toby and Audrey's dogs soon.
On July 11, 2023, Andrew ended the conversation by saying that Andrew and Audrey should talk later.

On July 24, 2023, Andrew and his girlfriend volunteered at a pet shelter. Andrew described the experience as joyful, rewarding, and a way to give back and improve animals' lives; he especially enjoyed seeing the animals content and happy.
Audrey has never volunteered at an animal shelter but said she would like to do so someday after hearing Andrew describe the experience.
Audrey has four dogs, whom she calls her four fur babies and considers more important to her than anything. Audrey shared a photo from a fun park outing showing a woman kissing a dog.

Audrey described her four dogs' personalities: the oldest is relaxed and wise like an old sage; the second is always ready to play; the third can be naughty but loves cuddling; and the youngest is lively and adventurous. Audrey adores their distinct personalities.
Max was Audrey's childhood dog. Max was energetic, loved playing fetch, and appeared in a photo shared by Audrey showing him sitting on a floor with a tennis ball.

When Audrey was a child, Audrey and Max took long neighborhood walks, explored new paths, and Max sniffed and marked his territory. Audrey shared her worries and hopes with Max because he was a great listener; those walks are among Audrey's favorite memories.

Andrew and Audrey believe pets are friends and confidantes who listen without judgment, provide comfort and unconditional love, help people feel seen and understood, brighten their days, and leave lasting emotional memories.

On August 4, 2023, Andrew said Andrew, Andrew's girlfriend, and Toby planned to go camping for the upcoming weekend, August 5–6, 2023. Andrew said it had been a long time since Andrew had been in nature.
On August 4, 2023, Andrew shared a photo showing a woman setting up a tent on a rocky hill.
By August 4, 2023, Audrey had started agility classes with Audrey's dogs at a dog park. Audrey enjoyed watching the dogs learn, build relationships with other dogs, and face and overcome challenges.

Audrey viewed dog agility as both a physical and mental workout for Audrey's dogs and as a bonding experience. Audrey took Audrey's dogs to the park twice a week for practice, although the training was sometimes difficult.

On August 4, 2023, Audrey shared photos of a dog in a field of flowers and grass, a dog jumping through an airborne ring, a group of dogs sitting on a dirt road, and a woman walking dogs down a trail.
Audrey and Audrey's dogs completed a trail hike on August 4, 2023; the hike took two hours and included many beautiful views and nature exploration.
On August 4, 2023, Andrew shared a photo of a dirt path in the woods with rocks and trees, describing it as a trail Andrew had just visited.

Andrew considers hiking Andrew's best outdoor activity. Andrew finds trees, fresh air, challenging trails, and reaching a trail summit refreshing; being in nature calms Andrew, relaxes Andrew's mind, and makes Andrew's worries feel as though they disappear. Andrew views nature as a break from the craziness of city life.
Audrey feels that nature refreshes people, offers refuge from busy city life, and is especially enjoyable when shared with someone special.

Audrey said Audrey's pets have supported Audrey through difficult times, bring Audrey happiness, mean the world to Audrey, and are beloved companions who make Audrey's days better. Audrey feels blessed to have Audrey's furry friends.
On August 4, 2023, Audrey shared a photo of a dog lying in a dog bed in a living room and a photo of three dogs sitting on a wooden floor and looking upward.
Andrew and Audrey agreed that bonds between humans and animals, and shared enjoyable experiences, bring substantial joy and love.
On August 4, 2023, Audrey asked Andrew what breed Toby is; Andrew had not yet answered the question in this conversation segment.

Andrew and Audrey are the speakers. Andrew owns Toby and has a girlfriend; Andrew planned an August 5–6, 2023 camping trip with Andrew's girlfriend and Toby and values hiking and nature for relaxation. Audrey recently started dog-agility classes with Audrey's dogs, practices twice weekly, and completed a two-hour trail hike with the dogs. Audrey deeply values Audrey's pets as loving companions. Audrey asked Toby's breed, which remains unanswered.
On August 4, 2023, Andrew said Toby is a German Shepherd and described German Shepherds as smart and loyal.
On August 4, 2023, Audrey agreed that German Shepherds are exceptionally loyal and intelligent and said Andrew would form an amazing connection with Toby.
On August 4, 2023, Andrew said he hoped to take Toby hiking because Toby would be an excellent hiking companion who shares Andrew's interests in exploration and the outdoors.
On August 4, 2023, Andrew shared a photo of a dog sitting on a rock in the woods, illustrating his idea of hiking with Toby.
On August 4, 2023, Audrey said German Shepherds enjoy new journeys and exploring outdoors, and imagined Andrew and Toby conquering trails together.
On August 4, 2023, Audrey shared a photo of a dog sitting on a trail overlooking a city.
On August 4, 2023, Andrew asked Audrey for advice about owning a puppy while living in a city.

On August 4, 2023, Audrey advised city-dwelling dog owners to ensure they have sufficient time and energy for a puppy, since puppies require substantial attention and walks. Audrey specifically said Toby, a German Shepherd, would need ample activity to offset his high energy.
Andrew planned to take Toby, his city-adopted German Shepherd puppy, on a small hike at a local trail on August 4, 2023.
Andrew wants to support Toby's growth without restricting Toby's development and intends to provide Toby with sufficient outings and activity.
Audrey advised Andrew that caring for Toby requires preparation and giving Toby the love he deserves.

On August 16, 2023, Audrey got a tattoo depicting her four dogs—Pepper, Pixie, Precious, and Panda—because the dogs mean a lot to Audrey and she wanted to carry them with her wherever she goes. Audrey shared a photo showing a person with the tattoo on their hand.
On August 16, 2023, Andrew went with his girlfriend to a farm to get fresh vegetables for dinner, and Andrew enjoyed the experience.

As of August 16, 2023, Audrey would like to have more pets eventually, but four dogs are enough for now because caring for Pepper, Pixie, Precious, and Panda already keeps Audrey busy and Audrey wants to give each dog adequate attention.
